questions.question: Tish olib tashlash jarayonida qanday asorat eng ko'p uchraydi?
questions.explanation: Tish olib tashlash jarayonida og'riq va noqulaylik eng keng tarqalgan asoratlardan biridir (Manba: Contemporary Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, 197-bet).
optionExplanations: To'g'ri — og'riq va noqulaylik eng keng tarqalgan asorat (Manba: Contemporary Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, 197-bet).
Xato — nafas olish qiyinligi odatda tish olib tashlash bilan bog'liq emas.
Xato — ko'ngil aynishi bevosita bog'liq emas.
Qisman to'g'ri — qon ketishi ham yuzaga kelishi mumkin, lekin kamroq uchraydi (Manba: Contemporary Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, 197-bet).
